resources.string: See where each app on your phone connects.
Android did not let Watch start. If another VPN app is set to stay always on, turn that setting off first.
Your phone\'s Private DNS is set to %1$s. Android sends the names that apps look up there, encrypted. This keeps them private from your network, but Watch cannot read them.
Your network\'s DNS server supports encryption, and Android uses it for the names that apps look up. This keeps them private, but Watch cannot read them.
Watch still names most connections from what each app sends, or by who runs the network they reach.
